environment.description: Go microservice deployed as a container on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with a public-facing listener on port 443. The ALB forwards all traffic to the target group without any managed rule sets or WAF association. The service is accessible to any internet user via the ALB's public DNS name. No Content-Security-Policy headers are set at the ALB or application level.

config.headers: No CSP, no X-XSS-Protection at infrastructure level
